data.name: Doaa
data.gender_notes: Doaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘duaa’, meaning prayer or supplication. It is a reminder of the importance of seeking Allah’s help and guidance in times of need. The name Doaa carries the meaning “Prayer, Supplication” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Doaa usually hope their child will grow to embody prayer, supplication and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the essence of faith and devotion, encouraging the bearer to constantly seek Allah’s mercy and blessings.
data.etymology: Doaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prayer, Supplication.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Doaa total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: دعاء
in_arabic.meaning: دعاء تعریف ہے، التجا، درخواست، فریاد، خدا سے مدد مانگنا
in_arabic.long_meaning: دعاء (د ع ا) جڑ سے نکلا ہے، جس کا معنی ہے التجا کرنا، درخواست کرنا، یا فریاد کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ دعاء ایک اہم عبادت ہے جس کے ذریعے مسلمان اپنے رب سے بات کرتے ہیں اور اپنی ضروریات کے لئے اس سے مدد مانگتے ہیں۔

in_urdu.name: دعا
in_urdu.meaning: دعا کا مطلب ہے التجا، درخواست، یا خدا سے مدد مانگنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: دعا (د ع ا) عربی جڑ سے نکلا ہے، جو دعا کے معنی میں ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور عبادت کی ایک قسم کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔ دعا کرنا اسلامی عقیدے کا ایک اہم حصہ ہے، جہاں افراد اپنے رب کے ساتھ باتचीत کرتے ہیں اور ان کی ضروریات اور خلوص کے لئے اس سے مدد مانگتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: दुआ
in_hindi.meaning: दुआ का अर्थ है प्रार्थना, याचना, या ईश्वर से मदद मांगना
in_hindi.long_meaning: दुआ (द उ आ) अरबी मूल से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रार्थना करना या याचना करना। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है और पूजा के एक रूप को दर्शाता है। दुआ करना इस्लामी विश्वास का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा है, जहां लोग अपने ईश्वर के साथ बातचीत करते हैं और अपनी आवश्यकताओं और सच्चाई के लिए उससे मदद मांगते हैं।

in_pashto.meaning: دعاء معنی دعا، غوښتنه، یا له خدای څخه د مرستې غوښتنه

in_english.name: Doaa
in_english.meaning: Prayer, supplication, or asking for help from God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Doaa is derived from the Arabic root 'd-ʿ-w', which means to call upon, invoke, or supplicate. In Islamic tradition, Doaa (or Dua) is a vital form of worship where believers communicate with Allah, expressing their needs, gratitude, and devotion. The name symbolizes a deep spiritual connection and is widely used across Muslim cultures to signify a life of prayer and devotion.

The name Doaa reflects the importance of this relationship, as it is a constant reminder of the need to turn towards Allah for guidance, strength, and protection.

In Islamic teachings, prayer is a mean of drawing near to Allah, a means of expressing gratitude, and a mean of asking for His blessings, guidance, and protection. The name Doaa serves as a constant reminder of the power and importance of prayer in attaining spiritual growth and seeking Allah's pleasure. It is a name that embodies the essence of faith and the pursuit of a deeper relationship with the Creator, inspiring the bearer to strive for spiritual excellence and seek Allah's mercy and forgiveness.
